title: JuriSwitch: Orchestration constraints for jurisdictional switchovers and automated evidence bundles
creator: Asha Patel
description: Design and implement an orchestration-level constraint system ("JuriSwitch") that prevents unauthorized cross‑jurisdiction data movement during regional failovers for Private/VPC/on‑prem customers. JuriSwitch must: 1) enforce residency policy maps so stateful artifacts (KV caches, local logs, ephemeral inference traces) only relocate to pre-authorized regions; 2) expose retention overrides and custodial retention windows tied to deployment profiles; 3) emit cryptographically verifiable evidence bundles describing what moved, why, and when; and 4) provide a deterministic decision path (circuit-breakers + staged migration) to avoid accidental policy violations during automated regional failovers.
acceptance_criteria: Policy engine enforces region allowlist: any attempt to spin up or migrate stateful resource to a non-authorized region is blocked and logged (automated test coverage >= 95%).
Retention window enforcement: 'custodial_retention' on private deployments is respected by cleanup jobs; test shows no artifact older than configured TTL remains after cleanup run in staging.

Evidence bundles are generated on every topology change affecting residency: bundle contains manifest (resource ids, checksums), signed control-plane assertion (KMS-wrapped), and relevant audit log slice; bundles are uploaded to customer-specified secure store (S3 or customer endpoint).

Failover decision path honors circuit-breaker thresholds: simulated regional degradation that meets threshold results in staged failover to approved region with manual approval gate if configured; automated fallback to quorum read-only mode when policy requires.
Security review completed and threat-model notes addressed; penetration test of evidence bundle signing validated by security team.
Documentation and runbook published in Confluence with step-by-step remediation and QA playbook.
E2E test matrix covering 'soft failover', 'hard failover', 'read-only quarantine', and 'no-move' scenarios with reproducible assertions and telemetry dashboards.
Backward compatibility: existing Dedicated customers with pin_policy remain unaffected unless explicit migration is requested.
Metric coverage: new residency_metric and evidence_bundle_created events emitted and visible in Console within 5 minutes of action.
technical_design: Core components: (1) Residency Policy Map service: canonical policy store with per-customer allowed_regions, resource_class rules, and retention_defaults. (2) JuriSwitch controller: subscribes to topology events (node failures, infra autoscale, manual evacuations) and consults policy map to compute allowed actions. (3) Migration orchestrator: implements staged move (prefix/KV cache snapshot -> transfer -> restore -> verification) with transactional checkpoints and rollback markers. (4) Evidence bundle generator: collects manifests, KMS-signed assertions, and audit-log slices; supports upload to S3, GCS, or customer webhook. (5) Circuit-breaker engine: policy-configurable thresholds (latency, error-rate, capacity) and predefined response modes (no-move, staged-move, manual-approval, read-only). Integration points: control-plane auth (service identity), KMS for signing, Console for policy UI and nudge/approval flow, and observability for metrics and traces.
runbook: Immediate actions (for operators): 1) If a region reports N+ failures or latency > 3x baseline, open JuriSwitch dashboard and check computed 'allowed_actions' for affected customer. 2) If 'no-move' is set, enable read-only quorum for the customer's tenant and notify SRE/SE. 3) For staged-move, follow automated approval webhook or invoke manual approval with reason and expected downtime. 4) To recreate an evidence bundle manually: run admin tool 'juriswitch-collect --tenant <id> --since <ISO8601>' which triggers signed bundle creation and stores to the configured evidence_store. 5) Rollback: if post-move verification fails, mark rollback=true in orchestrator to rehydrate original region (uses previous snapshot). 6) Escalation: if cryptographic signing fails, route to Security on-call and disable automated uploads until keys are rotated.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (canary): Deploy JuriSwitch controller in us-east-1 for 5 pilot customers with private deployments; watch metrics for 72h. Phase 2 (region expansion): add eu-west-1 and ap-southeast-1 with feature-flag gating; expose manual-approval toggle in Console. Phase 3 (GA): flip default to 'policy-enforced' for new private deployments, offer assisted migration for existing customers. Communication: customer webinar + migration playbook + updated SLA addendum.
qa_tests: Simulated region outage: cause node termination and verify orchestrator honors 'no-move' policy and evidence bundle is generated.
Retention enforcement: create test artifacts beyond TTL and run cleanup; assert artifacts removed and retention_metric incremented.
Signed evidence validation: verify KMS signature and bundle manifest integrity across rotatable keys.
Circuit-breaker thresholds: fuzz test thresholds and assert system enters expected response mode without policy violations.
Concurrency test: 500 parallel topology events across 50 tenants; verify orchestrator remains idempotent and bundles are consistent.
